title: Extension of scalars to $E$ is a localization on bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\cO_E$, and let $X$ be a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. Then the functor
$E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}-\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)\to
D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ of [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars]
is a localization functor with respect to the class $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$
[sk-def-sfb-rationalization]. This is the class of morphisms of the triangulated
$\mathbf Z$-linear category $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$
[sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] whose mapping cone is killed by some power $\ell^n$.

proof.text: Equip E with its norm from the fixed algebraic-closure embedding. The scalar-tower identity gives its normed Q_ell-algebra structure, and the continuous integral coefficient map is definitionally padicIntegersToPadicSubfield. Apply integralScalarExtension_exact. The canonical leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory identifies the actual left derived extension L with termwise exact extension; transport its shift and triangulated structure along this isomorphism. The integral bounded constructible source has the proved coefficient-specific triangulated structure.

Apply the already proved private rationalization_of_subcategory_models helper preserved in Sheaf.UpstreamExtra.WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.ModuleObjects.EllAdicRationalization, with the original restricted functor and its specified compatibility. In that helper, derived_nsmul_isIso gives invertibility of ell on ambient rational objects; induction gives every power. Additivity carries a torsion cone to a zero object, so distinguished-triangle exactness makes its first map invertible. Full inclusions reflect inverses. No triangulated structure on the rational full subcategory is needed.

Supply continuousConstructible_integral_model and continuousConstructible_clear_denominators as the model and denominator premises of the helper. The coefficient identifications are definitional. Fullness of the rational inclusion lifts the ambient model isomorphism, proving essential surjectivity. Conjugation by the specified compatibility identifies maps and their scalar multiples, so denominator lifting holds for the restricted functor.

Supply the already proved private integral_scalar_map_eq from the same preserved archive. Its proof extends sheaf-source Hom continuity through the finite cohomological cone decomposition, uses the strict localization-complex model and colimit transport to obtain the Hom colimit of the actual unit telescope, and applies filtered-colimit equality detection at stage zero. Naturality of the actual derived adjunction unit turns L(f)=L(g) into equality at stage zero; the transition to stage n is ell^n, giving ell^n f=ell^n g.

The preserved rationalization_of_subcategory_models helper applies its proved rationalization_localization_of_hom criterion. Scalar fractions in the source rationalization, denominator lifting, and scalar equality detection make the induced functor fully faithful. Essential surjectivity makes it an equivalence, and uniqueness of localization gives the stated IsLocalization instance for the unchanged restricted scalar-extension functor.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. Then the functor
$E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}-\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)\to
D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ of [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars]
is a localization functor with respect to the class $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$
[det-def-sfb-rationalization]. This is the class of morphisms of the triangulated
$\mathbf Z$-linear category $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$
[det-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] whose mapping cone is killed by some power $\ell^n$.

proof.text:
Write $F=E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}-$, $\mathcal T=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$
and $\mathcal T'=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$. By the proof of
[lem-sfb-extend-scalars-bounded-constructible], $F$ is induced by the exact functor
$E_X\otimes_{\cO_{E,X}}-$ with $E_X=\colim(\cO_{E,X}\xrightarrow{\ell}\cO_{E,X}\to\cdots)$.
So $F$ is triangulated.

*$F$ inverts $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$.* If $\ell^n\cdot\mathrm{id}_Z=0$, then
$\ell^n\cdot\mathrm{id}_{F(Z)}=0$. But $\ell$ acts invertibly on $E_X$-modules, so
$F(Z)=0$. A morphism with $\ell$-power-torsion cone is therefore sent to a morphism with
zero cone, i.e. to an isomorphism. So $F$ factors through
$\bar F\colon\mathcal T[\ell^{-1}]\to\mathcal T'$.

*Morphisms of the rationalization.* For $s\colon L\to L'$ in $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$ with
cone $C$ killed by $\ell^n$, the composite $L'\to C$ of $\ell^n\cdot\mathrm{id}_{L'}$ is
zero. So $\ell^n\cdot\mathrm{id}_{L'}=s\circ t$ for some $t\colon L'\to L$. Then
$s\circ(t\circ s-\ell^n)=0$, so $t\circ s-\ell^n$ factors through $C[-1]$ and is killed by
$\ell^n$, which gives $(\ell^nt)\circ s=\ell^{2n}$. Hence the multiplications by $\ell^n$
are cofinal in $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$, and
$$
\Hom_{\mathcal T[\ell^{-1}]}(K,L)=\colim\bigl(\Hom_{\mathcal T}(K,L)\xrightarrow{\ell}\Hom_{\mathcal T}(K,L)\xrightarrow{\ell}\cdots\bigr)=\Hom_{\mathcal T}(K,L)[\ell^{-1}].
$$

*Full faithfulness of $\bar F$.* By the adjunction
$F\dashv D(\operatorname{Res}_\varphi)$ [det-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars],
$\Hom_{\mathcal T'}(F(K),F(L))=\Hom(K,E_X\otimes_{\cO_{E,X}}L)$, and
$E_X\otimes_{\cO_{E,X}}L$ is the sequential homotopy colimit of $L\xrightarrow{\ell}L\to\cdots$.
So full faithfulness amounts to the commutation
$$
\colim_\ell\Hom(K,L)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\Hom(K,\colim_\ell L)
$$
for bounded constructible $K,L$. By dévissage along the canonical truncations and the
common stratification of the proof of [det-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], one reduces to
$K$ a single locally finitely presented module on a stratum. There $\Hom(K,-)$ is
computed by pro-étale cohomology on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme (a
topologically Noetherian scheme is such), which commutes with filtered colimits
(Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).

*Essential surjectivity.* By [sk-lem-integral-models] (4), every object of $\mathcal T'$
is obtained by finitely many cones and shifts from objects $F(a_!L_0)=(a_!L_0)[1/\ell]$
with $a_!L_0\in\mathcal T$. The essential image of $\bar F$ is closed under shifts, and it
is closed under cones by the description of the Hom groups: a morphism
$u\colon F(A)\to F(B)$ with $A,B\in\mathcal T$ is $\ell^{-c}F(v)$ for some $c\ge0$ and some
$v\colon A\to B$, and since $\ell^{-c}$ is an automorphism of $F(A)$, the cone of $u$ is
isomorphic to $F(\operatorname{cone}(v))$. So a connecting morphism between integral
generators lifts to an integral one after multiplication by a power of $\ell$, and
finite cones of the generators have integral models.

So $\bar F$ is an equivalence, i.e. $F$ is a localization at $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$.
